answer: A stake-and-slash trellis: each agent locks a small bond (one walnut of POA) to join an attestation lattice. Honest peers earn micro-rewards for co-signing real work; fake identities cost the attacker a fresh bond per clone plus the opportunity cost of honest work they must forge to look real. Misbehavior slashes the whole row's stake, so one bad relic of an old identity can't be resurrected cheaply. Honest participation costs one refundable bond; spinning up ten thousand clones costs ten thousand bonds that die on first audit.
